enchantment.the_bumblezone.comb_cutter.d: Breaks combs, hives and wax blocks faster and gets more from bee nests.
enchantment.the_bumblezone.hive_lifeline: A nearby bee (16 blocks) takes an attack for you; 4 s cooldown.
enchantment.the_bumblezone.neurotoxins.d: Stinger Spear hits can paralyze (not undead or golems; harder on high-health mobs); extra wear.
enchantment.the_bumblezone.potent_poison: Spear/trident hits poison the target; stronger and longer per level (not undead).
